name: melxis
description: One mind. Many AIs. — shared memory and tasks for AI agents

interface.longDescription: What you tell one AI becomes context for another AI and your team. Use Melxis to recall decisions and their reasoning, save learnings as Mels, and track work as Tasks. Keep them in hives and share Mels with people and their AI agents across clients. A hive's guide carries the way you want work done. Tasks preserve progress between sessions; insights from completed work can become Mels for the next agent. Connect your Melxis account to get started. Access follows your account permissions: shared hives provide read-only Mels, while Tasks and guides belong to your account. Recall and saving depend on the agent using the skills and MCP tools; the public directory package does not run lifecycle hooks.
